fields.headline: Material Cybersecurity Incidents
fields.nature: On October 22, 2026, the Company detected unauthorized activity on its information systems and determined that ransomware had encrypted systems used in manufacturing operations.
fields.scope: Production scheduling systems at two of the Company's five plants and certain file servers were affected. The Company's finance and payroll systems were not affected.
fields.timing: The Company discovered the incident on October 22, 2026, and its disclosure committee determined on October 23, 2026 that the incident is material.
fields.materialImpact: The incident has disrupted production at two plants and is reasonably likely to materially affect the Company's financial condition and results of operations for the current quarter.
fields.remediation: The Company engaged outside counsel and forensic experts, notified law enforcement, and has restored scheduling at one plant.
fields.notYetDetermined: The Company has not yet determined whether personal information was taken. It will amend this report when that information is available.
fields.forwardLooking: This report contains forward-looking statements about recovery that involve risks and uncertainties.

fields.headline: Other Events
fields.nature: On October 22, 2026, the Company detected unauthorized activity on certain information systems and took affected systems offline.
fields.scope: The activity affected systems at two plants. The Company is working with outside experts to understand the extent of the activity.
fields.timing: The Company detected the activity on October 22, 2026. Its assessment is continuing.
fields.materialImpact: As of the date of this report, the Company has not determined that the incident has had or is reasonably likely to have a material impact on its financial condition or results of operations.
fields.remediation: The Company engaged outside counsel and forensic experts and notified law enforcement.
fields.notYetDetermined: The Company will file an Item 1.05 report if it determines the incident is material.
